text:
Travel with care, made simple.

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to guide every companion animal journey with calm, practical support. Our welfare coordinator checks comfort needs before departure, and trained staff give each animal patient attention from the first greeting through the final handover. <<FACT F028>> Travelers can expect concise advice, clear next steps, and a warm response when plans shift. Whether you are arranging a first trip or supporting a familiar flyer, we are pleased to help make each journey steady, safe, and reassuring.
